title: Editor can crash when closing multiple tabs with `Close All Tabs`
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible: 4.8 dev 2 ~ 4.8 dev 5 and latest master [3756fbb] - Not Reproducible: 4.8 dev 1 ### System information Godot v4.8.dev5 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 120.00 Hz) - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(TM) B580 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.8993) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description The editor seems to have a race condition when closing multiple tabs, which can lead to errors or a crash. The amount of tabs seems to matter, as the more tabs you have to close, bigger the chances to trigger this bug:
